# Vitalia Login Panel - Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
Professional login panel for Vitalia (elderly residences) using React (Vite) + Tailwind CSS.

## Tech Stack
- React with Vite
- Tailwind CSS
- Ready for Vercel deployment

## Design Requirements
- Purple corporate color as primary
- White and soft green as complementary colors
- Responsive design (mobile, tablet, desktop)
- Smooth interactions with Tailwind

## Features
- Username field (free text)
- Password field
- "Remember me" checkbox
- Login button
- "Forgot password" link with modal
- Basic validation for empty fields

## Deployment Target
- Vercel
